summary: A yellow glow sits centered within a shadowy brick structure. Trinity fixes on it, sprinting with every ounce of energy she has left, then hurls herself out into the empty night space. Her body levels into a dive and she falls, arms covering her head, while the entire planet appears to rotate on its axis.
